caption: The drawing features a rectangular object, possibly a textile or clothing accessory, placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object has a light blue front panel bordered with pink edges and a visible pink side flap extending to the right. The blue panel is decorated with an embroidered design: a yellow floral motif at the top center, and beneath it, a symmetrical pattern comprising green, yellow, and white lines forming a curved, wave-like border, with red dots and blue teardrop elements along its edges. The artist’s name appears in small blue text towards the bottom right of the object. The composition is minimal, with the decorated rectangular object as the sole focus, positioned against an otherwise empty background.
title: Needle Case
